note: Kane's switch-on bar for every Jev decision (26 September), passed on by the coordinator. It replaces bar-v2's 5-point margin. It arrived after run 3 had been scored, so run 3 is judged under it here and this change is recorded with its date; no answer was re-asked.
rule: Jev goes on for Pro when the Jev-when-sure path (the Pro path) beats the name rule, the win is not luck (exact McNemar p < 0.05 on the paired units), and the Pro path makes no more harmful mistakes than the rule. The size of the win does not matter.
harmful: For relationships, a harmful mistake is a wrong join, a wrong cardinality or a wrong filter direction on a relationship the arm proposes (every rule proposal and every Pro-path proposal counts as proposed as sure).
unit: D1 join decides whether the family goes live, as in bar-v2; D0 and D2 to D4 are reported.
